snippet.title: Chained Beasts - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569420/Chained_Beasts/
Discord: https://discord.gg/X2PgBVzYR3
Newsletter: https://www.featherweightgames.com/newsletter

Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

GRUELLING GLADIATOR ROGUELITE
Choose your weapon, raise your shield and enter the Colosseum alone or with three friends in this chaotic gladiator roguelite. Master swords, spears, maces and flails as you come face to face with rival gladiators while shackled to each other. Endure physical and mental injuries as you perform for the crowd and fight to break your bonds.
 
WIN THE CROWD, WIN YOUR FREEDOM
Enslaved by the Emperor and cast into the dungeon, you must fight to earn your freedom. This is a blood sport, and the more spectacular your fight, the more the blood-thirsty crowd will be entertained. Catch opponents in your chains to throw them off balance, hurl their bodies at one another, or lure them into deadly spike pits and flamethrowers. Improvise with weapons thrown to you by an adoring crowd, and live long enough to leave them wanting more. 
 
OVERCOME YOUR WOUNDS
Heal your wounds and train to become stronger between each battle. But some injuries will leave a permanent mark that will change how you play. A broken leg, a missing eye, and paranoia-induced hallucinations are just some of the dozens of conditions that you and your fellow gladiators may suffer. Spend your coin on upgrades and unlock new beast masks to forge the ultimate gladiator. Fame, freedom and glory await, if you can survive until tomorrow.
